mapper.select: SELECT id, match_id, player_id, type, status, registered_at, cancelled_at, cancelled_by, updated_at, is_deleted FROM ( SELECT r.id, r.match_id, r.player_id, r.type, r.status, r.registered_at, r.cancelled_at, r.cancelled_by, r.updated_at, r.is_deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.match_id ORDER BY r.registered_at DESC, r.id DESC ) AS rn FROM registration r WHERE r.player_id = #{playerId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) latest WHERE latest.rn = 1 ORDER BY latest.registered_at DESC, latest.id DESC
